name: mojo-anything
description: Rewrite your app in Mojo, one piece at a time, checked against the original's recorded behaviour at every step: profile, bridge, record, diff, bench, shadow and gate, for TypeScript/JavaScript, Python, C, C++, Go, Ruby, Java and Kotlin, with whole-app record and replay for PHP and C#. Runs on Linux (x64, arm64) and macOS (arm64).
